summary: Super Group (SGHC) Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, announcing a regular cash dividend of $0.05 per share declared by its board on June 9, 2026. The dividend is payable on June 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 23, 2026. Combined with a prior Q1 distribution of $0.05 per share paid on March 30, 2026, total year-to-date dividends are $0.10 per share. CEO Neal Menashe cited strong cash generation and disciplined execution. The event is a routine capital return with no premium, advisory, or structural complexities. Watch for future dividend patterns as a potential signal of ongoing shareholder return policy.
